pages.title: Paraphernalia
pages.text: In addition to runes various occult paraphernalia are used to improve the intended effect of the pentacle.$(br)
Candles increase the stability of the pentacle, thus allowing a slowed essence decay of the summoned$(br) spirit, leading to a longer lifetime of the spirit, or possessed object or being.$(br)
Skulls increase the calling power of the pentacle, allowing to summon more dangerous spirits.$(br2)Occultists can find an easy way to obtain these skulls using basic possession rituals.$(br)
Crystals increase the stability of the pentacle, at levels that candles would not reach, allowing a performing more unstable rituals.$(br2)Check the recipes in next page.$(br)
